subject: general
question: Who wrote the book ‘Gulamgiri’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jyotirao Phule**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Jyotiba Phule was born to a Mali family in Satara (Maharastra).
 
• He fought against the Upper Caste domination.
 
• He also founded Satya Shodhak Samaj.
 
• His works like Gulamgiri and Sarvajanik Satyadharma became famous.
 
• He educated his wife at house, he faced criticism from society for educating his wife.
 
• His wife Savitri Bai Phule started the first girls' school in poona, which was the first of its kind started by an Indian.
 
• Jyotiba Phule also worked for the betterment of widows, and women.
 
• Savitri Bai Phule worked for the widow remarriage and education of women in society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
